source_scope: Direct facts from completed saved JSON and the finite saved AC/lid monitor. Independent event/thermal/native audits already replayed raw evidence; no new host workload.

five_minute_summary.scope: All-hop bins include seek replacements. Full-hour continuous p99 passes despite seven misses; the final complete bin p99 exceeds the target. Per-bin values are descriptive and do not add an acceptance gate.

recorded_parity.scope: Recorded success assertions and event hashes checked; successful PCM arrays are not retained/recomputed.

cancellation.range_scope: Retained control measurements; return instants are not separately reconstructible from events.
cancellation.scope: Exact discarded generation/request pairs and held-chunk rejection independently validated. Logical cancellation; active native GPU work drains. Hardware submission/preemption unobserved.

coverage.scope: Independent silent audio probe streaming interval; no stem playback claim

audio.measurement_scope: Callback execution and PipeWire-reported driver-position clock timing; not measured end-to-end audio latency, per-stream xrun recovery or a complete graph xrun count.

motion.scope: Saved low-frequency GUI property observations inside the workload; not per-frame visual or physical presentation validation

progress.exposure_scope: Sampled heartbeat exposure; spans end at recovery or workload stop, or remain open during the run

UI.scope: GUI-thread frameSwapped notifications; not physical presentation latency

notes: VmRSS, VmHWM and VmSwap are exact /proc/<pid>/status fields in kB.
DRM values retain their exact fdinfo field names and units; duplicate client IDs per device are sampled once.
Field type or unit changes are retained as separate observations; maxima are compared only within the same unit.
DRM client maxima can occur at different times; do not add maxima or combine them with RSS as a total or shared GPU peak.
CPU seconds cover the first through last successful sample, excluding earlier process work.
Process count fields retain exact stat/status names; status context-switch counts describe the main thread. Compare cumulative counters only within the same PID/start identity.
Full rows stream to the optional trace; observer memory retains per-process/client maxima and first/last counters rather than sample history.

native_policy.scope: Native snapshots only; no interpolation, stable-profile or private-latch claim.

thermal.scope: Retained native thermal snapshots inside the inclusive workload interval only. Any-sensor means the sampled and type-mapped sensors listed here, not all laptop sensors. Thresholds describe samples and do not establish sustained heat or a user-approved sustained threshold. No interpolation or continuous-duration proof; an isolated hot sample has zero first-to-last span. Adjacent cool observations bound an observation window, not the actual length of continuous heat. Missing observations break episodes; gaps between hot observations may hide recovery or further spikes.

AC_lid.scope: Sampled online/lid states and finite gaps do not establish uninterrupted AC or lid state between reads.

common_wait.scope: No benchmark load; common sleep/desktop idle inhibition remains owned by the outer wrapper.

expected_producer.scope: Frozen signed source and artifact identities supplied by root; launching remains an explicit root action after helper review

series_state.scope: Matched Vulkan/software 900-second trials, then a conditional software hour. The short software p99 and existing validity checks select whether to run the hour; only the full hour can assess its M0 target. Fixed order does not establish causation.

selection.scope: Selection of the conditional hour only; not a new acceptance gate or proof that M0 passes

UI_final_geometry.scope: Final recorded width, height and device-pixel ratio only; continuous geometry is not observed

comparison.scope: Recorded matched-duration configuration and artifact checks only. Renderer and its UI-only backend environment intentionally differ; run labels, output paths, PIDs and times differ. Fixed order, thermal/policy/cache history and background load prevent a causal guarantee.

existing_acceptance.parity_scope: Full same-grid chunks require identical SHA-256; trimmed seeks use allclose(rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5) and record exact equality/max difference.
existing_acceptance.active_cancel_scope: Wait 150 ms after the supervisor started event, then revalidate generation/request. No GPU submission timestamp is observed.
existing_acceptance.scope: synthetic saturated delivery with requested load=both; no stem playback/full deck or musical-quality claim

limitations: One full hour and fixed-order short comparisons do not establish a causal renderer speedup or repeatability across all host histories.
The software UI still runs under the Wayland compositor; only the Qt UI backend changed, while native inference remains Vulkan.
Synthetic load with independent silence and a small animated window does not establish musical-quality, audible-seam, actual stem routing, physical output latency or full-deck performance.
The final complete all-hop bin exceeds 4.095 seconds despite a passing full-hour continuous p99. No per-bin acceptance gate was added.
Short heat spikes are acceptable to the user; sampled peaks alone are not failures, unsampled sensors remain unknown, and no sustained threshold was invented.
Observed native graph timing includes execution/wait; sampled GPU frequency associations do not establish cause. Native/RSS/DRM maxima are separate and must not be summed into a total memory peak.
Logical cancellation does not demonstrate hardware submission/preemption. Successful PCM was not retained for independent numerical recomputation.
